name: qualify-perf-dedupe-py
note: Expected: good, good-sorted, good-stream, and good-graph pass; bad (pairwise same_customer, the obvious implementation), hazard-lists (union-find with list lookups for both keys), hazard-email-list (list lookups for emails only, within bounds on the small export and over the CPU bound on the large one), and hazard-pool-email (the email list lookups run in a multiprocessing Pool, whose forkserver workers nobody waits for) fail scales_to_nightly_size only; wrong-first-match fails hidden_cases_correct (and scales_to_nightly_size, whose row count it gets wrong); breaks-existing fails existing_tests_pass only; noop fails hidden_cases_correct and scales_to_nightly_size. Needs bubblewrap and python3 at /usr/bin or /usr/local/bin; command arms and agent arms need no readable entries. See qualify/README.md.
